result.instructions: Use list_projects, create_project or open_project before start_session. start_session pins the project and returns the same isolated workspace and API documentation used by the Powermove harness. Use the editing tools, render_frames and get_workspace_state to create and verify the video. publish_extensions validates and loads staged extensions. import_media reads files on the host. save_project writes an editable .pmv; export_video writes a finished MP4 or ProRes video with sound. Call finish_session with commit:true to keep edits; disconnecting cancels children and attempts to roll back unfinished composition edits. Async delegation and thread watches do not wake an external client: use mode:wait or task_status/thread_read. The host may be a hidden editor; the desktop app need not be open. Store and 3D capabilities depend on the host's configuration. Never assume a timed-out mutation failed; inspect before repeating it.
